{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any revenue value contains a comma
has_comma = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

print("Number of revenue entries containing commas:")
print(has_comma.sum())

print("\nFirst 10 revenue values with commas (if any):")
print(sales.loc[has_comma, 'revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
